summary: ITER 35 — Platform-enhancements backend test suite (18/18 PASS). Verified: (1) Super-admin bootstrap state for rmleetang@gmail.com (skipped cleanly when not in DB; otherwise asserts role==super_admin). (2) /api/admin/credit-grants gated to super_admin only — admin role and member role both receive 403, super_admin clears the gate. (3) June 2026 payout block — /api/payouts/status returns {locked:true, release_at:'2026-06-30T21:59:59+00:00', message containing '30 June'}, POST /api/withdrawals returns 403 with June message, /admin/withdrawals/{id}/approve & /mark-paid return 403 with June message (lock check runs before lookup). (4) /api/admin/users/by-score?bracket=N-M and ?min_score/max_score both work, return {bracket:[lo,hi],count,users[]} filtered to [lo,hi), admin-gated (403 for member), invalid bracket → 400. (5) /api/admin/users/{id}/score-breakdown?days=N returns full shape {user,window_days,totals:{events,points},by_action[],events[]} — totals sum, per-action grouping, admin-gated. (6) PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role fires _notify_role_change → inserts role_change notification doc AND writes audit_log row on BOTH grant and revoke (verified count_documents ≥ 2 after grant+revoke). (7) award_points has NO HARD CAP — seeded monthly_score=9990 + post_create with month_key=current resulted in monthly_score=10040 (> 10000), cap_reached_at + top_contributor_at set on first cross. (8) /api/posts user_score is LIVE — created a post with snapshot=100, bumped users.network_score to 700, fetched /api/posts, post.user_score == 700 (not stale 100). (9) is_official broadcast regression — admin can POST /api/posts {is_official:true} and the response carries is_official=true.

integration_issues.issue: Could not deep-test UI in this run because (a) /auth/send-otp no longer returns _mock_code when Brevo accepts the message (only present when delivered=false), and (b) injecting a minted JWT into localStorage on /login then navigating doesn't establish session — React auth context appears to read the token at app mount and the seeded user lacks photo/profile completion flags the UI requires. Backend tests fully cover the logic; recommend main agent perform UI smoke via an existing verified test user OR add a dev-only /api/auth/dev-token endpoint gated by an env flag.

action_items: (Frontend retest) The seven new data-testids listed above were NOT live-verified through Playwright in this run due to OTP/Brevo session friction. Main agent should self-test via an existing logged-in browser session OR provide a /api/auth/dev-token helper.

(Test ergonomics, optional) Consider re-introducing _mock_code on /auth/send-otp behind a DEV_MODE=true env flag so automated tests can complete the OTP flow without depending on Brevo deliverability.

(Carry-over from iter32, STILL unfixed per iter34) server.py promotion window-open notifier uses `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` which is broken — distinct returns a coroutine→List, not async-iterable. Fix to `for uid in await db.promotion_events.distinct(...)`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2842 create_post: indexes current_user['photo'] without `.get()` — if a user doc lacks the field (legacy/seeded), POST /api/posts will 500 with KeyError. Use `current_user.get('photo','')` defensively. Discovered while seeding test users in iter35.

server.py L5197 _notify_role_change: early-returns if email_verified is falsy, skipping the email send entirely. Reasonable for spam prevention but please double-check product intent — the spec says 'fires on BOTH grant and revoke for admin/moderator/ambassador/super_admin' and a freshly-promoted admin might not yet be email_verified.

server.py L6446 admin_set_user_role: hard-coded role whitelist excludes 'super_admin' from grants by non-super-admins (good) but the message 'Only the platform owner can grant super-admin role' uses 403 — confirm that the existing UI handles 403 vs 400 distinctively.

server.py L6541 admin_users_by_score: default limit=200, capped to 1000. UI bracket-filter for low-score buckets (0-1000) with thousands of seeded users will silently truncate — consider exposing total_count separately from len(users) so the UI can paginate.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) MONGO_URL='mongodb://localhost:27017' DB_NAME='test_database' JWT_SECRET_KEY=$(grep JWT_SECRET_KEY /app/backend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_platform_enhancements.py -v (~5s, 18 tests, all pass). Best approach is to (a) log in via an existing TEST_UI_* user the previous iter created, or (b) wait for main agent to expose a /api/auth/dev-token helper.
